integrity: Statement, proofs, and finite arithmetic checks are internally reviewed only; mathematical priority is assessed against the accessible original paper and public research records, with unindexed equivalents not excluded.
scientific_limitations: Counts rational tangent contacts of a plane-filling degree-(q+3) curve with smooth defining-field points; does not prove geometric smoothness of that curve or classify geometric tangent contacts away from the defining field. The genus-three auxiliary quartic is proved geometrically smooth. Finite checks are corroborative, not general proofs.
title: A genus-three tangent discriminant for plane-filling curves
